# Fee Tiers

{/* the table below is generated from the subgraph */}

<FeeTable chain="mainnet" />

Uniswap v3 supports four fee tiers: 0.01%, 0.05%, 0.30% and 1.00%.

<details>
  <summary>Why four tiers?</summary>
  Stable pairs need a tier far below what volatile pairs can sustain.
</details>

```solidity
function createPool(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint24 fee)
    external
    returns (address pool);
```
